title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF made significant strides in coordinating humanitarian efforts and enhancing its field presence. By strengthening internal mechanisms like the Emergency Management Team and engaging in external platforms, UNICEF improved response effectiveness. Key achievements included advocating for malnourished children, and establishing a new outpost in Menaka, ensuring timely support in challenging environments and a changing humanitarian funding landscape.;
